BatchEnrollAccounts.description_en: Applies an account baseline to multiple existing resource accounts at a time
BatchEnrollAccounts.description_zh: 批量为已有的资源账号应用账号基线

CreateAccountFactoryBaseline.description_en: Creates a baseline of the account factory

EnrollAccount.description_en: Creates a new resource account or enrolls an existing resource account in Account Factory
EnrollAccount.description_zh: 通过账号工厂创建一个新的资源账号或者纳管一个已有的资源账号

GetAccountFactoryBaseline.description_en: Obtains the details of an account factory baseline
GetAccountFactoryBaseline.description_zh: 获取账号工厂基线详情

GetEnrolledAccount.description_en: Queries the details about an account that is enrolled in the account factory
GetEnrolledAccount.description_zh: 获取账号工厂中注册账号详情

ListAccountFactoryBaselineItems.description_en: Queries a list of baseline items that are supported by the account factory of Cloud Governance Center (CGC)
ListAccountFactoryBaselineItems.description_zh: 获取云治理中心账号工厂支持的基线项列表

ListAccountFactoryBaselines.description_en: Obtains a list of baselines in the account factory
ListAccountFactoryBaselines.description_zh: 获取账号工厂基线列表

ListEnrolledAccounts.description_en: Queries a list of accounts that are enrolled in the account factory
ListEnrolledAccounts.description_zh: 获取账号工厂中注册账号的列表

ListEvaluationMetadata.description_en: Retrieves information about all available governance evaluation items, including names, IDs, descriptions, stages, resource detail metadata, and remediation guidance
ListEvaluationMetadata.description_zh: 获取所有可用的治理检测评估项的信息，包括名称、ID、描述、阶段、资源明细元数据和修复指引

ListEvaluationMetricDetails.description_en: Retrieves non-compliant resource information for a specified check item, including the name, ID, category, type, region, and related metadata of non-compliant resources
ListEvaluationMetricDetails.description_zh: 获取指定检测项的不合规资源信息，包含不合规资源的名称、ID、类别、类型、地域以及相关元数据

ListEvaluationResults.description_en: Get governance evaluation results and status
ListEvaluationResults.description_zh: 获取治理检测结果和状态

ListEvaluationScoreHistory.description_en: Retrieves the historical scores of governance detection
ListEvaluationScoreHistory.description_zh: 获取治理检测历史分数

RunEvaluation.description_en: Runs a Cloud Governance Center governance check
RunEvaluation.description_zh: 运行云治理中心治理检测

UpdateAccountFactoryBaseline.description_en: Updates a baseline of the account factory
